rigid_profile.candidate_rationale: Applies the released TRT and operator-locked simulation settings without speculative changes.
rigid_profile.prompt_instruction: Reproduce the supplied operator_faithful_baseline exactly. Apply only the changes explicitly approved by the operator and introduce no optional policy changes.

exploratory_profiles.prompt_instruction: Explore an allowed manipulator-priority alternative that may improve measured throughput while preserving every locked field and mandatory constraint.
Explore an allowed priority policy that favors timely completion of required tooling without changing operator-selected targets or intervention settings.
Explore allowed line-specific priority differences that may reduce imbalance across affected lines without changing operator-locked behavior.
Explore the smallest behaviorally distinct allowed policy change beyond the rigid baseline.
Use aligned state records to explore an allowed priority alternative for a plausible bottleneck, without claiming feasibility before simulation.
Explore an allowed manipulator-priority alternative intended to support orderly post-anomaly task flow while preserving the locked intervention mode.
Generate a final behaviorally distinct allowed priority policy that contrasts with earlier candidates and remains within all supplied constraints.
